tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi lag len dang ngag 'don dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgo nas las rab 'byams sbyin sreg gis sgrub par bya ba ni lag len gtsang zhing 'jug pa bde ba bri bar bya ste/ thog mar zhi bsnyen dang*/ de rjes zla gsang gzhi bsnyen man ngag dang ldan par thems nas/ las sbyor rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rdzogs par grub pa'i sngags pas/ sbyin sreg la 'jug pa la ni gnyis te/ spyir las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dang*/ khyad par bsnyen pa'i kha skong bya tshul sogs bshad pa gnyis so// dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po'i sdom ni/ brtag pa'i gzhi ru sa chog dang*// sa lha lhag gnas rdzas rnams bsag /thab bca' rdzas bsham las chu bsgrub// bsang dang bdag bskyed rdor dril bcang*// me lha'i mchod pa byin brlab cing*/ */de yi sreg rdzas bkru sbyang dang*// byin brlab me bsang sbar zhing gso// ku sha bkram pa rnams sngon 'gro// dang po ni zhi rgyas la dgun 'bring nyi ma chu srin gyi khyim du gnas pa/ yang na zhi ba karka ṭa'i khyim na zla ba dang seng khyim na nyi ma yod pa/ rgyas pa 'khrig pa dang bu mo'i khyim na lhag pa yod pa/ dbang glang dang srang na pa sangs yod pa/ bsad pa chu srin dang bum par spen pa yod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje nag po'i rgyud kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba rgyas par/ tshes gcig la ni zhi ba bya// zla ba nya la rgyas pa ste// bcu bzhi la ni mngon spyod do/ */dbang gi las ni tshes brgyad la'o// zhes gsungs pa'o// bcu bzhi pa drag po yar ngo'i bcu gnyis/ mar ngo'i nyer dgu la dgongs so// tshes ni gcig la zhi ba/ nya la rgyas pa/ tshes brgyad dbang*/ nyer dgu drag po/ thun tshod ni zhi ba srod/ rgyas pa snga dro/ dbang dgong kha/ drag po gung gnyis/ dbang yang gung gnyis la rung ngo*// gshin rje nag po las thams cad grub par byed pa 'khor lo'i rgyud las/

las rnams bsgrub par bya ba ni// mtshan mo nyi ma phyed nyid nas// zhes nyin gung mtshan gung kho nar drag po la bshad do// gza' skar ni/ zhi la zla ba dang pa sangs/ khrums smad dang gre skag mchu rnams/ rgyas par phur bu dang lhag pa// gro bzhin mon gru snar ma snron/ rnams dang*/ dbang la 'phel myur dang lang tsho phun tshogs sogs kyi sbyor ba/ dbang gi dgug pa la zla ba dang gro bzhin/ drag po la bdud nyi 'chi sbyor mi mthun mi 'phrod sreg pa sogs 'phrod sbyor ngan pa rnams so// khyad par zhi rgyas la 'char ba dang bdun pa'i dus sbyor la mig dmar dang spen pa dus me rnams yod pa dang biṣ+ṭi yang spang ngo*// de ltar las dang rjes su mthun pa'i dus tshod rnams sbyin sreg dngos gzhi'i dus bzang bar bya dgos pas de'i snga rol nas dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor zhi ba/ lhor drag po/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na grong la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi yongs su grags pa'i shar du zhi ba/ byang du rgyas pa/ nub tu dbang*/ lhor drag po'i las brtsams la/ de yang sa gzhi 'jam zhing dkar ba sogs zhi ba'i gnas/ ser zhing shing dang me tog sna tshogs bkra ba rgyas pa'i gnas/ dmar zhing me tog dang tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa dbang*/ nag cing rtsub pa g.yul sprad pa sogs bkra mi shis pa rnams drag po'i gnas so// gnyis pa sa chog ni/ rgyas par na sa brtag pa nas bsrung ba'i bar dang*/ gsum pa sa'i lha mo lhag gnas rnams dbang chog bdud dpung zil gnon gyi lhan thabs ltar bya/ bsdus par na rang lhar gsal bas zhing skyong la gtor ma phul la/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sam yang na gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa kun rdzob pas sbyangs pa/ chos thams cad stong nyid du mos pa don dam pas sbyangs pa'o// de rjes sa de la stegs bu thab kyi rgya tshad las che nges 'ong bar byas pa'i dpangs ji ltar 'tsham pa gru bzhir byas pa las mthun gyi kha dog bsgyur ro| |brus thab byed na thab kyi dpangs dang mnyam pa bya'o// bzhi pa rdzas bsag pa ni/

zhi ba la yam shing bal bu/ 'om bu/ kham bu/ lcang skya/ shug pa/ thang shing sogs dri zhim pa'i shing gi rtse mo las byung ba srid sor bcu gnyis pa sboms su mthe'u chung dang mnyam pa/ rtse gnyis 'o ma dang mar dang sbrang rtsi byugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri dkar po'i chus sbags pa/ rgyas pa'i yam shing rgyu zhi ba dang 'dra ba'am/ yang na 'bras bu can gyi shing gang yang rung ba de'i sked pa'i cha las byung ba'i srid du khru gang sboms su lag ngar phra ba tsam pa/ rtsa rtse 'o ma dang zho dang mar du bsnyugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri ser po'i chu dang mngar gsum gyis sbags pa/ dbang gi yam shing me tog dmar po can ro skyur ba tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa la srid du sor lnga/ yang na sor brgyad pa sboms su mthe'u chung gi phyed tsam pa/ rtsa rtse pho mo'i dri chur bsnyugs shing bdud rtsi dang dri dmar pos sbags pa/ 'jam gsum gyi yam shing ni rdol gas rul 'bus zos 'khyogs pa rtse gyes pa skam pa rnying pa 'phras pa sbam pa sogs min pa rlan dang shun pa 'dab mar bcas pa tshad mnyam pa kho na dgos so// drag po la ni seng ldeng dang*/ skyer pa dang*/ lci ba sogs ro kha zhing tsha ba tsher ma can/ yang na ro bsregs pa'i mgal dum/ de dag gang yin yang rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba bkas pa srid du sor bcu'am bcu gnyis pa sboms su srin lag tsam pa/ rtse mo gnyis rnon por bzhog pa/ 'jam gsum gyi yam shing gi mtshan nyid las go log pa la rtsa rtse nyungs mar dang khyi brun gyis byugs shing dug khrag dang ro skras sbags pa rnams so// mar khu ni 'jam gsum la mar dkar rang rang gi mdog mthun gyi dris sbags pa'i mar khu dang*/ drag po la mi la sogs pa'i zhun chen dang mar nag dug khrag gis sbags pa'o// kha cig dbang la tsha ba'i til dmar dri dmar pos sbags pa yang bshad do// de ltar yam shing dang mar gnyis ni sbyin sreg la gang byed kyang med mi rung ba'i rdzas yin no// khyad par gyi rdzas ni/

zhi ba la 'bru mar gyis byugs pa'i ku sha dang*/ til dang*/ 'bras dang*/ nas dang*/ gro dang*/ zho dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ 'bras zan dang*/ dūrba dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ pri yang ku dang*/ thang chu dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ gzhan yang tsam+pa ka la sogs pa dri zhim la kha dog dkar ba'i me tog gi rigs ji snyed pa rnams sbrang rtsis byugs shing nang gi bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'o// rgyas pa'i rdzas khyad par ba ni/ 'bras chan zho dang bsres pa la mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i zas mchog dang*/ gzhan yang zho dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ til nag dang*/ zho zan dang*/ zhun mar dang bcas pa'i 'bras dang*/ pad+ma ge sar dang*/ nā ga ge sar dang*/ 'bras bu'i rigs ci 'byor ba rnams dri ser pos sbags pa'o// dbang gi rdzas khyad par ba ni/ ut+pal dang*/ tsam+pa ka dang*/ mya ngan med dang*/ nā ga ge sar dang*/ gzhan yang me tog dang*/ 'bras bu ro bskyur zhing kha dog dmar ba dang*/ tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu can rnams dri dmar pos sbags pa'o// drag po'i rdzas khyad par ba ni/ yungs kar nag dang*/ tsha ba gsum dang*/ khrag chen dang*/ lan tshwa dang*/ ske tshe dang*/ nim+ba'i lo ma dang*/ thal chen dang*/ bong bu'i sbangs dang*/ ro skra dang*/ khyim bya'i tshil dang*/ tsher ma dang*/ mi rus kyi phye ma dang*/ de rnams thams cad ji tsam 'dzoms pa la bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi sa dang bshang gci la sogs pas sbags shing dug dang*/ lan tshwa dang*/ khrag gis byugs pa dang*/ thal chen dang*/ ro sol dang*/ phub ma dang*/ tsha ba gsum dang*/ bsgrub bya'i dri ma la byas pa'i liṅga gshin rje nag po'i las thams cad grub par byed pa'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rim par phye ba tha mar/ sreg rdzas gzugs chen la sogs sreg ces gsungs pas liṅga gal che/ bshad rgyud khri drug stong par/ liṅga sor bcu dbang po dod// skra gsil gsar bu khang stong pa// snying khar ming rus dpral bar rus// lte bar brla la bla dwags khams// gro ga la bris khog par bcug

/pha myes bu tsha spun yang bcug /nad rims gri khrag sna tshogs dang*// dug sna tshogs kyis phyir ni byug /de bzhin ka ko pi pi ling*// tsha ba gsum gyis phyi nas byug /rgyu rkyen nye bar gsod pa'i rkyen// mkhar gong srin can bar 'khris blong*// bang bu'i sa bon nad rnams 'du// sa dmar lus la tsha ba bskyed// nad khrag des bskyed dug snas gsod// drag po'i thod par byad du bcug /bdag la rgyab brten gan rkyal lam// spyi gtsug skabs sbyar dang po brnag gam// zhes gsungs/ mkhar sgong bang bu'i sa bon sa dmar po la liṅga 'bur dod/ tshon rdzas gzhan rnams phyi nas byugs pa sogs bya/ mchan/ sor bcu drug pa'i snying gar dug dang da dhu ra'i khu bas bsgrub bya'i ming rus spel tshig bcas bris pa bsgrub bya'i dri mas sbags pa bcug cing dug dang khrag gis byugs pa rnams so// de ltar las bzhi gang sgrub kyi rang rang gi rdzas khyad par ba 'di rnams shin tu gal che ste las 'grub byed kyi rtsa ba'i rdzas yin pa'i phyir ro// 'dir byad bskrad rmongs reng sogs bshad kyang de dag gi rdzas sngags ting 'dzin dang bcas pa gdug pa me'i las sbyor gyi kha bsgyur du bshad zin to// las bzhi thun mong du til dkar nag /yungs kar/ 'bras rjen/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i zas mchog /ku sha rtsa rtse ma nyams shing 'dab ma ma grug pa mar dang 'o mas sbags pa/ dūrba rtsa rtse ma nyams pa 'o mas sbags pa/ nas dkar mo/ gro/ 'bras dkar po ma grug pa/ sran ma/ so ba shun pa ma bud pa/ shing thog gi rigs ji snyed pa rnams so// de rnams kyang ma smin cing bam rul can ma yin pa/ sa rdo med cing so ba ma gtogs pa'i 'bru rnams shun pa dang bral ba/ de rnams thams cad gang 'dzoms la las mthun gyi kha dog can gyi dri dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa/ drag po la bsgrub bya'i rjes sa sogs dri mas kyang sbags pa dag go// las bzhi ga la til dkar nag phyin dang shing tog yan chad 'dzoms na rab la/

ma 'dzom na'ang rang don du gnyer bya dper na sdig pa zhi ba la til/ tshe'i bar chad zhi ba dang tshe rgyas pa la dūrba sogs sngags tshig gi rig pas las dang rjes su mthun pa gang 'dzom gyis kyang rung la/ khyad par nad gdon bgegs zhi bar 'dod na gu gul gyi ril bu mar la bsnyugs pa dag mchog tu shis so// gzhan yang mngar gsum dang*/ su pa ri/ a ru ra/ sgog skya rnams sbyar ba'i so rtsi 'jam gsum la rdo thal med pa drag po la rdo thal dang bcas pa/ rdo thal ni rdo tshos sol mes bsregs pa chang ngam chu la bskyur bas zho ltar song ba de nyid yin no// mchod rdzas ni thog mar chu bzhi ste/ zhi ba la/ dung ngam nya phyis kyi snod du 'o ma dang*/ shu dag dkar po dang*/ me tog dkar po dang*/ dri'i chu dkar po/ rgyas pa la/ gser ram/ dngul snod du zho dang*/ me tog ser po dang*/ dri'i chu ser po/ dbang la/ zangs kyi snod du me tog dmar po dang*/ dri'i chu dmar po/ de gsum ga la mchod yon la nas dkar po/ til nag /me tog dkar po/ 'bras/ ku sha/ 'o ma nang gi bdud rtsi lnga btab pa/ chu gzhan gsum nas dang*/ til nag dang*/ ku sha dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga yang blug go// drag po la ni/ longs spyad zin pa'i rdza phor chag dum thod tshal gyi snod du ko ṭa ba sogs dri nga ba'am dri med pa'i me tog nag po dang*/ bong bu dang*/ lci ba dang*/ gcin dang*/ khrag dang bcas pa'o// de rnams las 'jam gsum la spos dri zhim pa gang rung dang drag po la gu gul gyis bdug go// lha sngags sam las gshin gyi sngags mthar zhi ba la swā hā/ rgyas pa la oṃ/ dbang la hrīḥdang hoḥ dbang gi dgug pa la dzaḥ drag po la phaṭa btags pa lan bdun nam brgya rtsa bzla'o// nyer spyod ni/ zhi ba la dri zhim pa'i me tog dkar po dang 'o mas sbrus pa'i lha bshos/ rgyas pa la me tog dri zhim pa ser po dang zhos sbrus pa'i lha bshos/ de gnyis ka la thun mong du ga pur la sogs pa'i spos dang*/

mar dkar gyi mar me/ tsan+dan dkar po dang gur gum la sogs pa'i dri chab/ dbang la ro skyur ba'i me tog dmar po/ ar nag la sogs pa'i spos/ mar dkar gyi mar me/ tsan+dan dmar po la sogs pa'i dri chab/ mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i lha bshos/ drag po la dri nga ba dang dri med pa dang dug gi me tog /spos dkar nag sha chen dang sbyar ba'i spos/ mi dang nya la sogs pa'i zhun dang*/ yungs mar dang*/ tsha ba'i mar khu'i mar me/ du ru ka dang*/ 'o ma/ sih+la la sogs pa dang dug dang bsres pa'i dri chab/ kha ba dang tsha ba'i ro dang ldan pa 'bru nag la sbyar ba'i lha bshos dmar po gru gsum pa sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa rnams so// mchod pa kha dog bsgyur dgos pa rnams las dang mthun pa'i kha dog gis bsgyur ro// gzhan yang 'jam gsum la rang rang gi mdog mthun gyi gos zung gnyis re dang*/ drag po la zhing lpags sam ro ras nag po/ me lha'i gtor ma zar sgong lta bu pad+mas bskor ba dang*/ 'das gtor bra bo'i 'bru lta bu 'khor gru gsum bzhi dang bcas pa rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams so// lnga pa thab bca' ba ni/ sngar bshad pa'i stegs bu'i steng du thab ni bri rko rtsig gsum las/ bris thab ni/ las bzhi gar stegs bu'i steng du thig chen brgyad btab la/ zhi ba'i thab ni/ lte ba'i g.yas g.yon du gru phyed phyed gzhal nas zlum por bskor la/ de'i phyir sor mo bzhi re'i mchu dang kha khyer brkos la/ kha phyer rdo rje'am 'khor lo'i phreng ba dang*/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad sor bcu drug pa'i lte bar mgo shar du bstan pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po dkyus sor brgyad pa bri'o// rgyas par na las bzhi gang yin yang thab dbus su e mthing nag gi dbus dang phyogs bzhir yab yum sras lha gnyis dang bcas pa'i phyag mtshan sa bon bris na mchog tu legs so// spro na/ dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi'i lte bar e'i dbus su yab dang rtsibs bzhi la yum sras sbas lha gnyis rnams kyang bkod nyan no// rgyas pa'i thab ni/

tshangs thig g.yas g.yon du khru re gzhal te gru bzhir btab pa/ khru do sa'i phyi rol tu sor brgyad brgyad pa'i mchu dang*/ kha khyer yang gru bzhir btab pa'i kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba/ lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po che ser po sor drug pa bri'o// dbang gi thab ni| rgyar sor mo nyi shu'am khru gang pa gang rung ba dbyibs zla gam gyi phyir sor mo gsum mam bzhi re'i mchu dang kha khyer zla gam can la pad+ma dang*/ dbang gi dgug pa la lcags kyu'i phreng ba can lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma dmar po rdo rje lcags kyus mtshan pa bri'o| |drag po la logs re rer sor mo nyi shu pa zur gsum pa'i phyir mchu dang kha khyer sor mo gsum re gru gsum du btab ba'i kha khyer la khro bo'i rdo rjes bskor ba'i lte bar pad+ma nag po la gnas pa'i khro bo'i rdo rje sor brgyad pa bri'o// las bzhi ga'i thab kyi phyi rol tu sor mo gnyis re thab ngos su dor ba'i phyir thig gru bzhir btab pa ni stegs bu dngos te/ de'i grwa bzhir zhi ba la zla phyed la gnas pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum dkar po/ rgyas pa la zur bzhir zla phyed la rin po che ser po/ dbang dang de'i dgug pa la zur bzhir pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa'i lcags kyu/ drag po la zur bzhir khro bo'i rdo rje'am ral gri nag po bri/ thab kyi tshon ni/ zhi ba la sa dkar ram 'bras btags pa'i phye ma dang*/ ba'i lci ba dang*/ bdud rtsi dkar po dang*/ dri dkar pos khyab par byugs/ stegs bu'i steng du me tog dkar po'i gcal bkram/ rgyas pa'i thab la sa ser po dang*/ ba'i lci ba dang*/ bdud rtsi ser po dang*/ dri ser pos byugs/ me tog ser po'i gcal bkram/ dbang la sa dmar po dang*/ bdud rtsi dmar po dang*/ dri dmar pos byugs/ me tog dmar po'i gcal bkram/ drag po la sa nag po dang*/

bdud rtsi dang*/ dri nag po dang*/ thal chen dang*/ bong bu dang rnga mo'i sbangs gang rnyed kyis byugs/ dri ngan pa dang dri med pa'i me tog nag po dang phub ma sogs bkram mo// brus thab ni/ thab tshad mnyam pa'i stegs bu bcos pa la thur du 'bru ba yin la/ brus rtsig gnyis ka'i thab dang nang gi mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rgya'i tshad ni sngar bshad pa'i bris thab kho na lta bu la/ dpangs ni zhi ba'i thab dpangs khru phyed pa la/ de'i kha nas sor bzhi phyi la thad sor bskyed pa mu ran mchu/ de'i phyi 'gram nas steng du sor bzhi langs pa las/ slar phyir sor bzhi phyed phyed bskyed pa kha khyer ram 'dod snam yin/ thab nang gi pad+ma'i dpangs sor gsum dang rdo rje'am 'khor lo dpangs sor gcig pa'o// rgyas pa'i thab dpangs khru gang la phyir bskyed pa'i mchu sor brgyad la/ de las gyen du sor brgyad langs pa la/ phyir sor brgyad bskyed pa'i kha khyer thab nang gi 'khor lo'i dpangs sor drug pa/ de'i dbus kyi rin po che dpangs sor gnyis pa'o// dbang dang drag po'i thab kyi dpangs rang rang gi rgya'i phyed tshad la phyir bskyed pa'i mchu sor gsum gyi steng du sor gsum langs nas phyir bskyed pa'i kha khyer sor gsum pa la nang gi pad+ma dang lcags kyu dang khro bo'i rdo rje rnams dpangs sor gcig pa'o// kha khyer gyi mtshan ma rnams kyang dpangs su zhi drag dbang gsum sor re re rgyas par sor do pa/ kha khyer dngos kyang 'jam gsum la nang dang drag po la phyir bas kyis gzhol ba bya dgos so// thab bri rko rtsig gsum gang yang ma 'dzom na 'bru'am me tog gi tshom bu thab kyi dbyibs ltar bsgrigs pas kyang rung bar gsungs so// de rnams kyi bud shing ni/ zhi ba la/ nags kyi ba glang gi lci ba'am 'o ma can gyi shing srog chags med pa/ rgyas pa la/ kham bu star kha sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing*/ dbang la/ shing ro skyur ba me tog dmar po dang tsher ma lcags kyu lta bu yod pa rnams so// drag po la/

ro tsha ba dang*/ bska ba can/ tsher ma rtsub pa dang*/ dri ngan pa'am dri med pa'i shing dang*/ ro bsregs pa'i shing gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud las/ dur khrod shing ngam bong bu dang*// rnga mong sbangs skam bud shing ngam// sor gcig gis ni dma' ba yin// zhes gsungs so// mchan/ la bya'o// yang na 'jam gsum la yul grong las rgyang ring du 'phags pa'i ljongs kyi ba glang gi lci ba skam po srog chags med pas rung bar gsungs so// de'ang shing dang lci ba gang rung yin yang bri thab kyi mu ran gyi steng gi nang du sum cha gcig tsam du bskor bar rang rang gi rgya'i phyed tshad kyi dpangs dang ldan par brtsigs/ nang du'ang dgang*/ brtsigs brkos kyi thab khung nang du zhi ba la thab las cung zad dpangs dma' ba/ rgyas pa la thab dang dpangs mnyam pa/ dbang drag la ji ltar ran par thab nang du brtsig go// de dag gi me tshang yang las mthun so so'i phyogs sam shar lho nyid du byas kyang rung ngo*// drug pa rdzas bsham pa ni/ de ltar 'du byas pa'i rdzas rnams 'jam gsum la rang gi g.yas/ thab khung gi g.yon du las dang kha dog mthun pa'i ras sogs kyi steng du/ yam shing mar khu til yungs kar// zas mchog ku sha durba nas// gro 'bras sran so 'bras bu'i tshogs// 'dir go rim 'di ltar byas pa ni/ sgrig sla ba'i dbang du byas kyi/ don la bsham pa dang 'jig 'das gnyis kar 'bul ba'i tshe sogs yam shing dang mar khu ni thog ma kho nar bya la/ gzhan rnams sdig pa sbyang ba la til/ tshe rgyas pa la durba/ bsod nams rgyas pa la 'bras/ bgegs zhi ba la yungs kar sogs so so'i spel tshig gi don ltar las/ gang gtso bo bsgrub pa'i rdzas de nyid/ yam shing mar khu'i rjes rdzas gzhan rnams kyi snga rol du bshams pa dang 'bul ba ni lag len du bya dgos so// zhes rdzas bcu gsum mar khu ma gtogs tshar gnyis tshar du sbrengs te bshams pa'i thab khung ngos nang mar cung zad nyung ba me lha'i dang*/

phyi ma mang ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sreg rdzas dang*/ rang gi g.yon thab khung gi g.yas su stegs kyi khar mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ bsang gtor rnams bshams pa'i chu dang po gsum gyi mdun du so so'i bzed zhal yang mañji sogs kyi steng du bzhag /bsang gtor gyi snod du ku sha'i chun po bcug bzed zhal mi dgos/ rang dang thab kyi bar du me yol shing ngam rdo sogs bslangs pa'i thab khung ngos su rgyar mtheb sor bcu gnyis dang dpangs su khru phyed yod pa'i gangs ri'i gzugs kyang bri/ me yol gyi nang du stegs kyi khar rang ngos su 'das lha'i nyer spyod kyi mthar 'das lha'i gtor ma dang*/ thab khung ngos su me lha'i nyer spyod dang de'i mthar me lha'i gtor ma bshams/ de rnams kyi mthar so rtsi dang so so'i gos zung yang bshams/ de dag gi nang logs su/ rdo rje dang dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ sman raka/ las bum/ ku sha/ rlung g.yab sogs nyer mkho rnams dang*/ rang gi g.yas sam mdun du bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa dang gtor ma yang bshams/ rang gi nye logs g.yas su mar khu'ang bzhag go// drag po la ni/ rang gi g.yon ngos su sreg rdzas dang*/ g.yas su mchod rdzas bshams pa sogs 'jam gsum las go ldog pa bya'o// de dag thams cad la las chu nas ku shas 'thor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bzlas la bsangs/ de rjes mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas thams cad la sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la bzhag go// bdun pa las chu bsgrub pa ni/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na las bum sngar bsgrubs pa de nyid kyis chog la ma 'brel na las bum du las gshin bskyed bzlas sam/ las gshin ma bskyed kyang de'i sngags brgya phrag sogs bzlas la bsgrub bo// brgyad pa bsang ba ni/ las gshin gyi sngags bzla bzhin pas de'i chus bdag dang thab rdzas yo byad ma lus par 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du lan gsum mam bdun sogs kyis bsang ngo*// dgu pa bdag bskyed ni/

'jam gsum la rang nyid khrus byas te/ zhi ba la/ lus dri zhim pos byugs la gos rgyan dkar po dang ldan pas ku sha'i khri la pad+ma'i 'dug stangs zhes pa/ byin pa g.yas pa'i steng du g.yon pa bzhag la kha shar du phyogs pas 'jam zhing dul la byams pa dang snying rje'i sems kyis cho ga la 'jug /rgyas pa la/ gser dngul sogs rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pas byug pa dang*/ gos ser po dang bcas pas khri mthon po la bzang po'i 'dug stangs zhes pa/ rkang pa gnyis drang por bsrang ba'i byams bzhugs kyis kha byang du bltas la dga' zhing spro la tshim zhing gzengs bstod pa'i bsam pas bya/ dbang dang de'i dgug pa la/ byug pa dang gos dmar po dang ldan zhing me tog dmar po'i phreng ba'i rgyan dang bcas pas mtho zhing bde ba'i stan la rdo rje'i skyil krung zhes pa/ byin pa g.yas pa'i dbus su g.yon pa bzhag nas de'i steng du brla dang byin pa g.yon pa'i dbus su rkang pa g.yas pa bzhag la kha nub tu bltas la brtse zhing gcug la chags pa'i bsam pas bya'o// drag po la/ sngon du khrus mi bya bar lus dri mi zhim pas byugs la sra ba'i stan nam/ ro ras sam/ stan med pa'am/ bsgrub bya'i gzugs kyi snying gar byug pa dang gos nag po'am/ mi lpags sam/ khrag gis bgos pa'i gos dang bcas la/ mi rus sam sbrul gyi rgyan dang ldan pas rkang pa g.yas brkyangs bas kha lhor bltas la/ rgyu dus kyi kun slong snying rje chen po la de dus kyi kun slong khro 'khrug rngam zhing rtsub pa'i bsam pas sos so 'cha' zhing mig gdong tshugs su blta bzhin khro gnyer can du byas la/ de'ang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sham thabs bla gos rnam par spangs/ gos gzhan rnams la bkag ma yin// shin tu drag por de mi rung*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa'i las bsgrub pa la nyan thos kyi cha lugs gal mi che zhing sbyin sreg la 'jam gsum la'ang so so'i rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa bya zhing*/

khyad par drag po la ni sham thabs dang bla gos nges par spang dgos pa lung tshad ma 'dis grub bo| |deng sang sbyin sreg la chos gos med mi rung du go ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i go ba spyi tsam yang ma chags par zad do// de nas skyabs sems rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos sogs skyabs sems dang*/ ma rig rgyu las sogs snying rje rnam gsum| mchan/ sngon du btang nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar byas rjes las mthun gyi bsnyen pa'am/ yang na zla gsang gzhi bsnyen ltar ram dbang chog gi bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas pas grub la/rjes thun bsdu ba phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal la gnas/ mchan/ dbang bskur gyi rjes sam rab gnas dang sgrub mchod sogs dang 'brel lam/ yang na rang nyid bdag gi rnal 'byor la gnas bzhin pa yin na 'dir ma byas kyang 'thus so| |bcu pa rdor dril bcang ba ni/ sngon nas lhag gnas byas zin pa'i rdor dril la/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dang*/ dril bu aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ ces dang*/ thal mo ā di kā dis yongs su gang ba las lag g.yas su nyi ma dang*/ g.yon du zla ba gsal bar gyur pas rnam lnga 'dod kor byas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rdo rje g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis snying gar bzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hūm̐/ zhes g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang ming med kyis dril bu sku g.yon par bzhag /slar rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol bzhin pas/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra prats+tsha li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā/

nā da swa bhā wa/ badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho hoḥswā hā/ zhes brjod la rdo dril sbyin sreg ma grub bar 'bral med du bcang ngo*// bcu gcig pa me lha'i mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'jam gsum la lag g.yas pas g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon pas g.yon skor du las gshin gyi sngags bzlas shing las chus thab rdzas dgang blugs dang rang nyid kyang bsang*/ slar nang mchod kyis bsangs la/ sbyin sreg gi thog mtha' kun tu bdag dang lha mchod sbyin thab rdzas la sogs pa 'khor gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad ngo bos ma grub cing rang bzhin med pa/ stong pa nyid las med bzhin snang ba sgyu ma lta bu'i ldang ba bcos min yod na de nyid dang*/ med na tshul de lta bu dran shes bzhin yang yang gsal 'debs pa shin tu gal che bar yin no// swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las las dang rjes su mthun pa'i snod zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil| bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang bcas pa rnams las mthun gyi kha dog dang*/ rgyu la ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin can lha thams cad dgyes pa bskyed nus pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur par bsam pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad/ zhes pa sbyar bas me lha'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bcu gnyis pa sreg rdzas bkru sbyang ni/ gong ltar las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsang chu dang nang mchod kyi rdzas rnams las mthun du bsangs la/ lag gnyis khu tshur kha sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis sbrengs ba rtse sprod pa rdzas rnams la gtad de/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams bkrus par bsam/ slar phyag rgya de nyid yam shing la gtad de/

oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la gtad de/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams la gtad de/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hā/ rdzas lhag ma rnams la gtad de/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rdzas rnams bkrus te ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad dag nas stong par gyur par bsam/ bcu gsum pa sreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las zhun mar la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i rdzas rang rang gi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rang rang gi bya ba byed nus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa las mthun kha dog can du gyur par mos nas/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs so// bcu bzhi pa me bsang zhing sbar ba ni/ zhi ba la/ bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi me'am/ sbyin sreg byas shul gyi me'am/ tha mal pa dgon pa'i me'am/ me shel las byung ba sogs gang yang rung*/ rgyas pa la/ rgyal po'i me'am/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang gi me'am| me shel las byung ba'i me/ dbang la/ smad 'tshong ma dang rje'u rigs kyi khyim nas byung ba'i me/ yang na me tog dmar po can gyi shing rtsub pa las byung ba'i me'o// dbang gi dgug pa la/ gar mkhan dang tshong pa dang sprang pos lam du bus pa'i me/ drag po la/ ro bsregs pa dang*/ rdo dang lcags brdabs pa dang*/ gdol pa dang yug sa'i me rnams gang rung ngo*// me de rnams las mthun gyi me snod du bzhag pa las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsrung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs la/ slar las gshin gyi sngags kyis dpal 'bar gyi rgyu'ang yam shing gi rgyu 'dra ba byed do// mchan/ dpal 'bar sbar la/ dpal 'bar gyi me'ang las gshin gyi sngags kyi las chu dang nang mchod kyis 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du lan gsum bsangs shing*/ shin tu skam zhing gtsang ba'i ku sha'i chun po dang lhan cig thab tu bcug la/

oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing rlung g.yab kyis sbar/ bco lnga pa me gso ba ni/ mar khu blugs gzar bdun las gshin gyi sngags bzla bzhin pas blugs la me sbar ro// rlung g.yab ma gtogs kha'i rlung dang gos kyi mtha' g.yab pa sogs gtan nas mi rung ngo*// bcu drug pa ku sha dgram pa ni/ ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams shing ma grug pa ha cang mi ring ba thogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ zhes bzlas nas/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// swā hā/ zhes brjod cing ku sha gnyis gnyis bshibs pa g.yas skor du bkram ste/ thog ma'i dus zhi ba la rtse mo shar/ rgyas pa la byang*/ dbang la nub tu bstan la/ de rjes phyogs gzhan gsum du'ang g.yas skor du bkram snga ma'i rtsa ba phyi ma'i rtse mos non par bya/ drag po la g.yon skor gyi thog mar rtse mo lhor bstan la bkram/ de rjes las bzhi gar ku sha'i chun po ba glang gi rna ba lta bu thab steng du las mthun gyi phyogs su rtse mo bstan la g.yogs so// gnyis pa dngos bzhi'i sdom ni/ dngos gzhi thab bsang sbyang zhing bskyed// me bsang me lha bskyed spyan drangs// bzhugs gsol bgegs bskrad mchod cing bstim// chu bzhi nyer spyod phul la bstod// dam bsgrags byon zan dgang blugs gsum| |me pra brtag la ngan na zlog /yam shing dbul la rdzas gzhan rnams// gang 'byor dbul zhing khyad par rdzas// phul rjes zhal bsil bsang gtor dbul// me lha 'od zhu 'das lha yi// mchod rdzas sreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs// me dbus lha bskyed bsnyen pa'i bar// las gzhung bsrang zhing byon zan du// dgang blugs gsum dbul phyi nang bsang*// de kho nas mchod bstod pa bya// bsnyen pa byas mthar yam shing mar// sreg rdzas gzhan rnams gang 'byor dang*/

khyad par rdzas dbul phrin las bcol// zhes so// dang po thab bskyed pa ni/ las gshin gyi sngags dang chus 'jam gsum la g.yas skor du thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gshin rje pho mo/ ma he/ chu glang*/ pad+ma/ nyi zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar

po/ ser po/ dmar po/ nag po/ las mthun la zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas dang dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bsgyings pa gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba la/ ye shes kyi thab khung zlum po dkar po/ rgyar khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma'i lte bar 'khor lo rdo rje rtse lnga pas spras pa/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse gsum mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsam/ rgyas pa la/ gong ltar lha bskyed/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi thab khung gru bzhi ser po/ rgyar khru do/ zabs su khru gang pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rin po ches spras pa/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rin po ches mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsam/ dbang la/ gong ltar lha bskyed nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi thab khung zla gam dmar po/ rgyar sor mo nyi shu'am khru gang pa/ zabs su de'i phyed dang ldan pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la pad+ma dang lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa'i lcags kyu dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsam/ drag po la/ gong ltar lha bskyed nas/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes kyi thab khung khru gsum nag po/ rgyar sor mo nyi shu dang*/ zabs su sor bcu pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i kha khyer la khro bo rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma nag po'i lte bar khro bo'i rdo rje nag po rwa rnam par gdengs pas spras pa/

stegs bu'i grwa bzhir khro bo'i rdo rje ral gri nag pos mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur par bsams pas bskyed do// gnyis pa me lha bskyed pa ni/ me las gshin gyi sngags dang las chus 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ yig gru gsum gyi spras pa'i dbus su/ a las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ las bgrang phreng de yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba la/ skad cig gis rdzogs pa zhi ba'i me lha 'dzin byed sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum rtsa zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad gdangs pa zhi ba'i nyams can chu dkyil la gnas pa/ gos dkar po bgos shing srad bu dkar po'i se ral kha thogs pa/ me lce dkar po'i 'od zer stong gis dkris shing gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi cod pan can pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyas pa la/ skad cig gis rdzogs pa rgyas pa'i me lha dbang chen sku mdog ser po/ ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum rtsa zhal bzhad cing cher gdangs pa'i nyams can sa dkyil la gnas pa/ gos ser po bgos shing srad bu ser po'i se ral kha thogs pa/ me lce ser po'i 'od zer stong gis dkris shing nga rgyal gshin rje'i gshed kyi cod pan can bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ dbang la/ skad cig gis rdzogs pa dbang gi me lha dmar po sku mdog dmar po/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum rtsa zhal brtse zhing chags pa'i nyams can 'dzum bag gis 'gyings pa me dkyil la gnas pa/ gos dmar po bgos shing srad bu dmar po'i se ral kha thogs pa/ me lce dmar po'i 'od zer stong gis dkris shing 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed kyi cod pan can rdo rje'i skyil krung gyis bzhugs pa/ drag po la/ skad cig gis rdzogs pa drag po'i me lha rlung chen sku mdog nag po/

nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum rtsa zhal ches cher gdangs pa khro 'khrug khams gsum za ba'i nyams can rlung dkyil la gnas pa/ gos nag po bgos shing srad bu nag po'i se ral kha thogs pa| me lce nag po'i 'od zer stong gis dkris shing phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed kyi cod pan can g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ zhes bsgyur nas de bzhi ga thun mong du/ phyag drug dang po gnyis rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug gu rtse gsum dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ smin ma dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa ral gri'i thor tshugs can lto ba 'phyang zhing sha rgyas pa bongs thung ba/ snying gar me'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdo rigs kyi mtshan ma la yi ge raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur par bsam| gsum pa spyan drang ba ni/ me lha'i dam tshig sems dpa'i snying gar mtshan ma'i raṃ yig gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu nam mkha' la 'phros pas/ ri rab kyi me mtshams nas me lha ye shes sems dpa' dam tshig sems dpa'i cha lugs lta bu la 'khor drang srong gi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ lag g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung*/ g.yas rdo rje ku sha dang bcas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong bskyod pa'i rtse mo srin lag gi rtsa bar 'dzugs pa mi 'jigs pa bskyod pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ e hi e hi ma hā bhū ta/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// de wa ri ṣi dwi dza sat+ta/ lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog /ma gri hī twa ā hu ti ma hā/ sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// asmin+san+ni hi to/ 'dir ni yang dag bsten mdzad nas// bha wa ya mā ri ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ gshin rje'i gshed po'i bka' bzhin mdzod// ces dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/

ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūm̐/ zhes spyan drangs/ bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ rang byung chen po bcom ldan 'das| |'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'dod pa ster// me lha las kun sgrub byed pa// 'dir ni gdan la nye bar bzhugs// ku sha ā sa naṃ ku ru/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha me mtshams kyi thab kyi kha khyer du ku sha'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ lnga pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ phyir 'brang gi bgegs thams cad oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza gnod byed 'byung po uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsang chu gtor nas bgegs bskrad/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar chu bzhi 'bul/ drug pa mchod pa ni/ oṃ ag+na ye puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ sbyar bas mchod/ sman raka gtor gsum 'bul/ bdun pa bstim pa ni| oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dzaḥ de bzhin du dzaḥzhes pa'i mal du hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing lag pa rdor dril 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'i tshul dang se gol gtogs pas/ me lha dam tshig pa la ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya ba dang*/ mnyes par byas pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// brgyad pa chu bzhi 'bul tshul ni/ bsdus par ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ sbyar ba'o// 'bring du na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du sngags gzhan gsum ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su bcug pa'o// rgyas par na/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye ar+ghaṃ sogs chu bzhi sbyar bas mchod/ de'i tshe mchod yon ni bzed zhal gnyis par 'bul/ zhabs bsil bzed zhal gsum par 'bul/ zhal bsil bzed zhal dang por 'bul/ de gsum la chu'i snod nas me tog blangs pa bzed zhal du dor zhing chu'ang bzed zhal so sor sbreng*/

de rjes bsang gtor gyi snod nas ku shas blangs la bzed zhal dang po nyid du lan gsum 'bul lo// dgu pa nyer spyod ni/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes me lha'i sngags btags pa'am ma btags pa'ang rung la/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shapada'ang sbyar du rung bas mchod/ sman raka gtor ma 'bul lo// bcu pa bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ṭa k+kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces gzhan yang*/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyang ba'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs bsregs pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs| |rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gha ṭī rnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes slob dpon byang chub snying pos mdzad pas bstod do// bcu gcig pa dam bsgrag pa ni/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bong gis mnan lhag ma gsum so sor bsgrengs pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya yang na lag pa gnyis rdo rje phyi bsdams la gung mo gnyis gshibs nas kyang de'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun du rwa'i tshul dang mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis rwa re re ste rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya/ mchan/ bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wa la dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmiṃ ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum gyis dam la bzhag pas me lha rang gi dam tshig la gnas par gyur par bsam/ bcu gnyis pa byon zan ni/ dgang gzar 'dzin pa'i tshe zhi ba la lag gnyis so sor mdzub mo brkyangs/ gung mo dang srin lag mthe'u chung bskums pa mthe bong gis mnan pa byang chub mchog gi khu tshur/ rgyas pa la gung mo brkyangs gzhan gsum bskums pa mthe'u bong gis mnan pa rin po che'i khu tshur/ dbang la srin lag brkyangs gzhan gsum bskums pa mthe bong gis mnan pa pad+ma'i khu tshur/ drag po la mthe'u chung brkyangs gzhan gsum bskums pa mthe bong gis mnan pa khro bo'i khu tshur rnams las mthun du bcangs pa'i 'jam gsum ni/ 'jam gsum la g.yon kha steng du blta bas dgang gzar nang du mar gyis bkang ba bzung ba'i steng du g.yas pas khu tshur las mthun kha mthur du sbubs pas blugs gzar mar gyis bkang kha gyen du bstan pa bzung la/ mar khu blugs gzar gsum ngam bdun sogs 'byor tshogs dang bstun pas/ drag por de las go ldog la/ me lha'i zhal zhi rgyas dbang gsum la/ cung zad gdangs shing 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i ljags dang*/ drag po la/ zhal cher gdangs pa khro ba dang bcas pa'i ljags la rdo rje'i rnam pa/ las bzhi ga thun mong du/ las mthun gyi kha dog can la raṃ yig dang*/ dgang blugs kyi kha la hūm̐ yig las mthun gyi kha dog can 'od zer dang bcas pas mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ 'jam gsum la lag gnyis kyi gru mo pus mo'i phyi rol las mi 'da' bar g.yas blugs gzar bzung nas g.yas su lan gsum bskor ba dang*/ drag po la g.yas dgang gzar dang g.yon blugs gzar bzung bas g.yon du lan gsum bskor la/ de'i tshe 'jam gsum la snyan pa'i gdangs dang*/ drag po la nga ro drag pos/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya a dī bya/ ā bi sha ya ā bi sha ya/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ye swā hā/

zhes me lha'i sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs kyi sngags la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes mar gyi sreg blugs kyi sngags btags pa gang rung gis lan gsum du phul la/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe dgang blugs sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar brtsegs nas bzung la/ sngags brjod nas 'bul ba'i tshe dgang blugs kha sbyar nas 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor du 'bul lo// sbyin sreg gi gong 'og thams cad du dgang blugs 'bul tshe rol chen bya dgos/ mchan/ de dag gi tshe sngags mthar 'dod gsol gdag pa ni sngags mtha'i swā hā'i mal du/ zhi ba la/ gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ gang dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa che ge mo wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang gi dgug pa la/ gang 'gugs par 'dod pa che ge mo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhrīṃ/ drag po la/ dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa| ces so sor sbyar ba gal che'o// de ltar phul bas me lha dgyes bzhin du bzhes te sreg bya 'dzin pa'i dam tshig la gnas nas sreg blugs len cing phrin las gang bcol sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par gyur to zhes bsam/ bcu gsum pa me pra brtag pa ni/ 'od snye las/ rab sngags dge ba'i me yi 'od// dpal be'u dang ni rnga yab gdugs// rgyal mtshan pad+ma bum pa dang*// rtse gsum pa dang ral gri nya// bkra shis in+d+ra go pa dang*// rdo rje dung la sogs pa dang*// dgang gzar blugs gzar rnam pa dang*// dkar dang ljang 'dra mdog sdug dang*// g.yas su 'khyil dang shin tu snum// byu ru yi ni mdog 'dra ba// lug ru dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya// 'di 'od 'bar mtshungs dri ma med// du ba med cing dri gshin pa// pi wang rdza rnga'i sgra ldan mchog /zhi bar kha dog dkar por snang*// rgyas pa la ni gser dang mtshungs// dbang la dmar po rtse mo mchog

/mngon spyod la ni sngo nag go// zhi ba'i las la sogs pa la// gser 'dra rtse gcig dam pa ste// rtse gnyis 'bar pa 'bring du dran// rtse gsum sprin 'dra shin tu dman// zhes so// de'i dus kyi la nye yang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gzhan yang la nye bzang po dang*// 'dab chags dga' ba'i sgra dag dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs yangs pa'i sgra| |rgyal ba rnams kyis bsngags pa dang*// bkra shis bzang por rab bsngags dang*// rnam pa sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra// gdug dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*// de bzhin mchod yon bum pa dang*// mthong na grub pa 'i rgyud rnams yin| |rnam pa du ma'i kha dog gi// 'jig rten gyis mchod rab bsngags pa// de dag mthong na grub par 'gyur/ zhes so// yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sreg pa'i rang bzhin myur 'tshig pa'i// me ni mi dge ba ru 'dod// ces sreg rdzas 'tshig pa ha cang myur ches pa dang sngags mkhan mes ha cang gdung ba yang mi dge bar gsungs so// de yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ dge la mi shis gsungs pa gang*// de ni gdug pa'i las la shis// mngon spyod la ni mi shis gang*// de ni dge la shis par gsungs// zhes sngar bshad pa'i me pra bzang po rnams drag po la ngan la/ ngan pa rnams drag po la shis par gsungs pas skabs phyed par bya'o// bcu bzhi pa ngan na bzlog thabs ni/ las gang yin yang de dang rjes su mi mthun par me pra ngan na las gshin gyi sngags dang las chus me la bsang gtor bya/ lha sngags kyis bsangs/ lha sngags la/ bgegs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā btags pas dgang blugs bdun me lha la dbul/ de rjes gong ltar las chus bsang gtor byas nas slar me lha'i sngags kyis dgang blugs bdun nam gsum mam gcig 'bul lo// 'di ni me pra bzang na mi dgos so// me pra brtag pa 'di 'ga' zhig gis sbyin sreg gi thog mtha' kun tu byed par bzhed kyang skabs 'dir kho nar bya ba paṇa grub kyi gzhung dang mthun la yun ring na rkyen la ltos pa'i 'bar lugs sna tshogs pa 'ong srid pas yid brtan med cing*/

me pra nges nges kyang sngags pa dam tshig la gnas shing rim gnyis la drod thob par 'byung gi gang rung la mi 'byung ngo*// kha cig gis sreg rdzas la pra brtag pa sogs byed pa ni khungs rnam dag med pas rang bzo 'ba' zhig go// bco lnga pa yam shing dang mar khu dbul ba ni/ sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad rnams su bod snga mas/ mar thog mar de nas rdzas gzhan rnams mthar yam shing 'bul ba rgyud tshig gi go rim dang bstun mdzad la/ bod phyi mas slob dpon a bha yas/ 'dir ni go rim yam shing dag /bsregs nas yam shing me la mar// til dang dūrba 'bras zho zan// ku sha la sogs bsreg par bya// zhes yam shing thog mar phul nas me cher 'bar ba na mar khu la sogs pa rdzas gzhan rnams 'bul bar gsungs pas de'i rjes su 'brang ba'i phyag len ltar bya ba ni/ de'ang 'jam gsum la yam shing dang*/ ku sha dang*/ dūrba rnams lag g.yon pas snying gar bzung*/ g.yas pas ku sha dang durba gnyis gnyis zung du 'bul/ yam shing ni zung ngam re re phul yang nyan par lus rnam dag rnams bzhed 'dug /gnyis zung du sbyar ba rtse mo lha la bstan la 'bul ba'i tshe/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas g.yon pa'i 'og nas phyi ngos nas/ nang du tshur/ bskor nang nas yang*/ la g.yon pa'i steng slebs pa'i tshe mchog sbyin gyis thab tu dbul/ drag po la ni de rnams go ldog la dbul/ mar khu ma gtogs pa'i rdzas rnams blugs gzar ram lag pas 'bul ba gang bde bya/ lag g.yas pas 'bul na snga ma ltar bskor la 'bul/ mar khu ni bod kha cig dgang blugs brtsegs nas kha sbyar te 'bul ba la dgang blugs dang*/ blugs gzar rkyang pas 'bul ba sreg blugs yin gsungs pa mkhas 'dod kyi rnam dbye tsam ma gtogs rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun te dus 'khor rgyud 'grel las/ gong gi sreg blugs te dgang gzar mar gyis bkang nas zhes gsungs pa'i phyir yam shing gi rjes kyi mar khu 'bul ba 'di dgang blugs kha sbyar ram blugs gzar rkyang pas 'bul ba gang bde byed chog

/'jig 'das gnyis la rdzas so sor bshams pa sngar bshad pa nyid legs la/ gal te yul dus kyis tshar gcig las med na skabs 'dir rdzas 'bul rim bzhin so so'i phud bcad la bzhag pa rjes su 'das lha'i skabs bsres te dbul dgos so// rdzas rnams yul gang du 'bul na 'od snye'i dgongs pas mar khu la sogs pa zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du'o// yam shing dang*/ dūrba dang*/ ku sha dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mi rus kyi phye ma rnams ni sku'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la'o// zho zan dang*/ 'bras rjen sogs bza' ba dang*/ zhabs bsil dang*/ 'thor 'thung dang*/ til dang*/ nas la sogs pa ni phyag tu'o// dri rnams thugs kar ro// me tog rnams ni dbu la'o// zhabs bsil ni zhabs la'o// mar me dang mchod yon ni mdun du'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bdag dang*/ lha dang*/ rdzas dang*/ yo byad thams cad gdod nas ma grub kyang med bzhin du snang bar rtogs pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba bcos min yod na mchog yin la/ de 'dra med na bdag lha yo byad thams cad gdod nas ma grub kyang sgyu ma bzhin du med bzhin snang ba yin snyam pa'i rtog pa bcos nas sbyin sreg gi thog mtha' bar thams cad du yang yang bsam pa ni las rab 'byams gang sgrub pa rnams grub byed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo gal po che yin pas ma brjed par byos shig gu/ de ltar yid la nges par byas nas/ yam shing la/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra yadz+nyā ya/ zhes me lha'i sngags la rdzas sngags so sor btags pa'am ma btags pa rdzas sngags kho nas kyang rung la/ spel tshig ni spyir las gang sgrub dang khyad par rdzas rang rang gi spel tshig sbyar ba ste/ zhi ba la/ yadz+nyāk+s+ya'i mthar rang gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo zhes sam dmigs bsal med na/ bdag gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar gcod 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams dang zhes sbyar te mthar/ yang*/ khyad par rdzas rang rang gi spel tshig yam shing la/

khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar/ rgyas pa la/ gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo zhes sam dmigs bsal med na/ bdag gi tshe dang*/ bsod nams/ dpal 'byor/ mnga' thang*/ snyan grags/ blo gros la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes dang*/ dbang la/ gang dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa che ge mo zhes sam dmigs bsal med na/ bdag gi dbang du khams gsum/ srid gsum/ lha 'dre mi gsum/ chos nor/ dpal 'byor phun tshogs rnams dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes so// dbang gi dgug pa la ni dmigs bsal kho na ste che ge mo dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhrīṃ/ zhes sam/ drag po la dmigs bsal yod na dgra'am bgegs che ge mo zhes dang med na/ bdag la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs/ 'byung po/ dam sri/ byad phur/ rbod gtong la sogs pa rnams dang*/ khyad par gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces sbyar/ de ltar rdzas 'og ma rnams la'ang las gang sgrub dmigs bsal med na spyi khyab gong ltar dang rdzas rang rang gi spel tshig ma 'khrul bar sbyar nas/ mar khu la/ oṃ ag+na ye= khyad par 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bcu drug pa rdzas gzhan dbul ba ni/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya= khyad par sdig pa'i gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ yungs kar la/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sa dhā ya= khyad par bgegs kyi gnyen po phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de= khyad par bde ba mchog phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya=

khyad par bsrung ba mchog phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ dūrba la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe= khyad par tshe phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya= khyad par shugs phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri ye= khyad par nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya= khyad par bsod nams rgyas pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya= khyad par stobs rgyas pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya= khyad par nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ shing tog sna tshogs la/ oṃ badz+ra sho pa le= khyad par rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa ste sngags mtha' khyad par gyis gang du las mthun gyi dmigs bsal lam dmigs bsal med na spyi mthun sngar bshad pa ltar sbyor/ bcu bdun pa khyad par gyi rdzas las bzhi so so'i skabs bshad pa rnams gang yin so so'i bsres pa/ oṃ ag+na ye/ zhes me lha'i sngags mthar las gang sgrub kyi 'dod gsol sbyar bas dbul/ sha sna tshogs 'bul ba bla med la bshad pas dbul/ spro na rdzas khyad par ba 'bul tshul ltar skabs 'dir 'bul lo// yam shing byang chub kyi shing gi sngags/ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa zhes 'byung na'ang byang chub kyi shing bod du med pas sngags tshig 'di mi 'thad/ gzhan der mos na ni rdzas gzhan rnams la'ang brjod dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na mchod sbyin gyi shing spyi'i sngags yadz+nyā ya zhes yam shing spyi'i sngags su gsang ldan gyi sbyin sreg las gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

shing tog la sbyin sreg la lar/ a sa ma dhi pha la ya/ zhes dang*/ la lar/ ga ga ni ga ga ni bi lo ki te/ zhes 'byung mod do// badz+ra sho pa le ni bilba dang star kha sogs kyi sngags yin par mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil chog tu bshad pas 'di ltar byas pa khungs dag go// de'ang lan re re la sbyor nus na rab ma nus na bdun sogs kyi mthar de'ang mi nus na rdzas re re ji tsam 'bul ba'i thog mtha' gnyis su sbyar ba'ang rung ngo*// de rnams rang gang 'byor ma gtogs grangs 'di tsam kho na 'bul nges pa med pas 'byor na brgya stong ma 'byor na gang 'byor/ de'ang rdzas thams cad grangs mtshungs dgos pa'ang min te spel tshig khyad par ba de'i tshig don dang mthun pa'i las gang sgrub de nyid grangs mang du phul bas chog go// grangs 'dzin pa'i tshe me lha 'jig 'das gang la'ang gcig nas brgya sogs ji tsam 'bul ba 'byor tshogs dang bstun la grangs ltar chags byed pa ma gtogs gcig bcu nyi shu sogs grangs rkun byed pa ni lha la'ang g.yo sgyu'i bsam sbyor yin pas gtan nas mi rung*/ dgang blugs dang sreg rdzas sde tshan re re phul ba'i mthar rol chen yang bya dgos so// bco brgyad pa zhabs bsil dang bsang gtor ni sngar chu bzhi'i skabs sngags rgyas bsdus 'bring gsum bshad pa gang rung ngam yang na/ oṃ ag+na ye ā tsa mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhal bsil dang*/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor 'bul lo// bcu dgu pa me lha 'od du zhu ba ni/ 'das lha bskyed pa la me lha thab kyi me mtshams su bzhugs par bsam pa dang*/ me lha'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du dang*/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam pa gsum gsungs pa las/ tshad ldan gyi gzhung rnams su phyi ma ltar mang bas 'dir yang phyi ma ltar byas te lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bong lag mthil du bkug /sor mo gzhan bzhi so sor bsgreng ba 'bar ba ltar byas pa me lha'i phyag rgya bstan la/

oṃ ag+na ye dzu hu dzu hu swā hā/ zhes brjod pas me lha tshim zhing mnyes par gyur par bsam/ slar sngags de brjod cing se gol lan gsum gtogs pas/ me lha thab kyi nang du me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// nyi shu pa 'das pa'i me lha'i mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pas/ nyer gcig pa 'das pa'i me lha'i sreg rdzas bkru sbyang bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa rnams ni sngar me lha'i skabs ltar 'dir sbyar ro// nyer gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha bskyed pa ni/ bar 'dir bsgrub bya la phrin las mdzad pa'i dmigs pa bya bar gzhung du kha cig tu gsungs kyang 'das pa'i lha la rdzas rnams phul nas phrin las bcol ba'i tshe phrin las mdzad pa'i dmigs pa bya ba skabs su ma bab pas 'og tu bya'o// 'dir lha bskyed pa dngos ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na slob dpon gyis thab nang du gdan rnams bskyed/ slob mas dkyil 'khor nas lha sngags brjod cing maṇ+ḍal sogs kyi steng du tshom bu bkod la mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams mar me gcig las gnyis mched ltar byon par bsams la/ tshom bu slob dpon la phul nas slob dpon gyis tshom bu rnams thab dbus gdan so sor gnas ma 'chol bar rang rang gyi sngags brjod cing thab tu dor ba'i tshe lha rnams rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ sbyin sreg zin nas yang sngar ltar thab nang nas tshom bu'i mtshon te spyan drangs nas dkyil 'khor gyi kha khyer la rang sngags brjod cing tshom bu rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha gnas so sor dor bas lha rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha so sor thim par bsam/ spros pa la dga' na/ tshom bu spyan 'dren pa'i tshe spos kyis sna drangs rol mo gdugs sogs dang bcas pa'ang rung*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na lha bskyed lugs rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rgyas par ni/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las e chad nam mkhar gyur/

yaṃ las rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar ngag 'don dkyus ltar 'byung rim lha gtso 'khor bsrung ba'i gur khang bcu gsum dang bcas pa bskyed/ bsdus pa ni/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su ya ma ti ra baṃ zhes pas gshin rje pho mo'i gdan zhes pa nas/ rbad ya zlog ya zhes pas bskor bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyi rjes su/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa nas/ mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur gyi bar bya/ de ltar rgyas bsdus gang la'ang gtso bo bskyed dus rang nyid ces pa dang yum bskyed dus rang tshe bdag tu gsal ba'i zhes pa dang*/ bskyed lugs rgyas pa byed skabs srung 'khor gyi mgo'i yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang bh+yo las sogs kyi skabs rang gi ces pa'ang dor/ bskyed lugs rgyas bsdus gnyis kar gtso bo'i sku mdog zhi ba la/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar la zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ zhal lhag ma g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba/ rgyas pa la/ sku mdog rtsa zhal ser po tshim zhing rangs pa'i nyams can/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ dbang la/ sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar po brtse zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo/ drag po la ngag 'don dkyus kho nas chog go// 'khor bzhi po'ang sku mdog las mthun du bsgyur/ thugs ka'i rtsibs bzhi'i 'jam dpal yang zhi rgyas dbang gsum la bsrung ba'i skabs ltar dang*/ drag po la zlog bsad kyi skabs ltar bsgyur bar bya'o// nyer gsum pa byon zan dbul ba ni/ thog mar me tog yungs kar chu dang ḍa ḍi'i sngags bcas kyis sbyang ba 'di ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon 'ong rgyu min no// lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me tog dang yungs kar chu dang bsres la me'i phyogs mtshams kun dang rdzas thams cad la gtor zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi phaṭa/ ces brjod pas khyad par du sbyangs la/

lha thams cad ljags tha mi dad pa las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog can 'od kyi sbu gu can gyi rnam pa la hūm̐ yig las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog can 'od 'bar bas mtshan par gyur par bsams nas/ dgang blugs 'dzin tshul las mthun gyi khu tshur sngar me lha'i skabs bshad pa ltar byas la dgang blugs mar gyis bkang ba brtsegs pa bzung nas/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags mthar dgang blugs kha sbyar ba 'jam gsum la g.yas dang drag po la g.yon skor du 'bul/ de 'dra ba lan gsum gyi bar 'bul lo// nyer bzhi pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho nas mchod pa ni/ rgyas par na zla gsang gyi sku gzugs dbang po skyon sbyang rab gnas kyi cho ga'i skabs bshad pa rnams gang rung 'dir sbyar la/ bsdu na thog mar chu bzhi sngar me lha'i skabs bshad pa'i bsdus 'bring gnyis gang rung ltar bya/ yang na chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa kun lha sngags dang spel bas rung ste/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ sbyar ba phyi mchod/ nang mchod ni/ gong gi sngags kyi wā ra'i mthar/ pañca in+d+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ma hā maṃ sa dhū paṃ= ma hā dra ha dī paṃ= ma hā san+ta gan+dhaṃ= ma hā maṃ sa keṃ ni ri ti nai wi d+yaṃ= ma hā shā na shapadaṃ= zhes sbyar bas mchod/ gsang mchod ni/ gong gi sngags kyi wā ra'i mthar/ a nu rā ga ya pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ gong gi sngags kyi wā ra'i mthar/ pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ so sor btags pa sman raka gtor mas mchod/ nyer lnga pa bstod pa ni/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la/ thabs mchog bde chen ma sbas lha bcu+ug pa dang*|

drag po la bstod ring gis bstod do// nyer drug pa bsnyen pa ni/ zhi rgyas dbang drag so so'i spro bsdu man ngag gi gnad dang ldan pas a kro bcu bdun pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa/ ya ma bcu bdun pa gsum gang rung gi mthar las bzhi gang byed gi sham bu btags pa brgya stong ci grub bzla ba gal che'o// yang gtso bor so so'i bzlas pa byed na lcags sdig nas gsungs pa dang*/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags zur du bris yod pa ltar ram/ min na yang zlog gi e ka ya ma sogs kyi mtha'i srung zlog gi sham bu dor ba'i mal du hūm̐ phaṭa btags pa'i mthar las mthun gyi sham bu sbyar ba bzlas na shin tu legs so// 'das lha'i sreg rdzas logs su med na byin rlabs sngar byas pa des chog la logs su yod na sngar ltar rdzas byin rlabs byas te/ nyer bdun pa yam shing dang mar khu 'bul ba ni/ 'dzin tshul dang skor tshul sngar me lha'i skabs ltar las/ 'dir lha sngags dang spel lugs gsum du 'byung ste/ bsnyen sngags/ mtshan sngags/ sgrub sngags gsum gang rung gcig gis 'bul te/ bsnyen sngags ni yab la a+yai thung kho na te/ a+yai a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yadz+nyā ya/ zhes pa'i mthar spel tshig las gang byed kyang sngar me lha'i sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i skabs kho na ltar 'dir yang sbyor/ mkha' lding la/ a+yai khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐/ yum la/ a+yai ma mā e ka tsa ti hūm̐/ zhes so// sras la/ a+yai ya ma rā tsa kro dha hūm̐/ sku sprul la/ oṃ ya ma yak+sha hūm̐/ gsung sprul la/ oṃ ya ma rak+sha hūm̐/ zhes so// gtso 'khor so so'i bsnyen sngags 'di rnams ni gshin rje lcags sdig nas so// yang mtshan sngags byed na yab la/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mā ri a bhi bhu ya ā yur+pa ti hūm̐/ mkha' lding la/ oṃ dz+nyā na ga ru ḍa hūm̐/ yum la/ oṃ mā trī ma mo e ka dzā ti ru dhī rāk+ṣi hūm̐| sras la/

oṃ pu tra wa ra ya ma rā tsa hūm̐/ sku sprul la/ oṃ murti nirmā ṇa ma ra ṇa pa ti hūm̐/ gsung sprul la/ oṃ wāk+nirmā ṇa prā ṇa pa ti hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams so// yang sgrub sngags byed na yab la/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum la/ oṃ he ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa/ sras la/ oṃ gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa/ sku gsung gi sprul pa gnyis pa/ oṃ sarba tsit+ta gzir thuṃ bhig nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes sprul pa gnyis sngags gcig pu 'di ga yin yang lha sngags gnyis pas lan gnyis bldab nas 'bul lo// de ltar 'bul ba'ang me lha dang 'dra ba la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par 'dir sngags rnams kyi hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba'i mthar spel tshig sbyar ba zla gsang gi rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin no// nyer brgyad pa rdzas gzhan rnams ni til nas shing tog gi bar lha'i bsnyen sngags mtshan sngags/ sgrub sngags gsum po bshad ma thag pa gang rung gi mthar rdzas sngags dang las mthun gyi spel tshig me lha'i skabs ltar sbyar bas grangs ji tsam 'os pa phul te/ yam shing dang mar khu med mi rung la rdzas gzhan rnams gang 'dzom gtso bo la brgya stong sogs/ 'khor la de'i phyed ma sum cha sogs kyis 'bul/ de'ang rdzas rnams grangs mnyam mi dgos pas rdzas rnams gang 'byor la/ las gang sgrub pa'i spel tshig dang mthun pa'i rdzas de gang mang 'bul lo// nyer dgu pa khyad par gyi rdzas las bzhi po gang yin gyi rdzas khyad par ba so sor bsres pa'ang lha'i bsnyen sngags/ mtshan sngags/ sgrub sngags gsum po gang rung gi mthar las mthun gyi sham bu btags pas dbul/ sha sna 'bul bar gsung pa yang spro na lha sngags la las mthun gyi sham bu btags la dbul lo// de rjes dbang gyi dgug pa la/ shing dmar po'i byang bu la bsgrub bya'i gzugs dang ming rus bris pa'ang lha sngags mthar de'i sham bu btags pas dbul/ drag po yin na liṅga la sbyin sreg gi snga rol nas 'gugs 'dren gnas spar mkhyen dgongs nas gtun rdung gi bar byas/

mchan/ grub na dang*/ ma grub na skabs 'dir byas rjes mi bsad pa'i mtshon chas dum bur gtubs la drag bskul gyi mthar tshogs tha ma'i skabs ltar bstab bo bya zhing*/ mchan/ gzugs de'i rkang pa g.yon nas rim gis a kro bcu bdun pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa dang*/ ya ma bcu bdun pa gsum gang rung gi mthar ram/ yang na yang zlog gi bsad sngags kyi mthar/ dgra bgegs che ge mo dz+wa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces rim gyis sreg cing dmod bcol bya'o// na mo bla mas thal mo lan bdun brdab bo// de ltar sreg rdzas spyi dang khyad par ba rnams 'bul ba'i tshe bar bar du me gso ba'i phyir dgang blugs gsum re yang 'bul zhing bud shing yang rim can du me la bzhag go// las gshin bskyed pa med kyang skabs 'dir las gshin sreg rdzas 'bul dgos pas/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa kyi mthar yam shing nas rdzas khyad par ba'i bar 'khor rnams las nyung tsam 'bul lo// sum cu pa phrin las bcol ba ni/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon tshe'i bdag po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tshad med pa thugs rje chen po mnga' ba'i mthus/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mgon po kun tu gzigs pa'i go 'phang dam pa myur ba nyid du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa spyir btang dang*/ zhi ba la/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag la gnod pa'i nad gdon la sogs pa gang zhi bar 'dod pa che ge mo zhi bar mdzad du gsol lo shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag gi tshe dang bsod nams sogs gang rgyas par 'dod pa che ge mo 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

dbang la/ khyad par du'ang nor dang 'bru la sogs pa gang dbang du 'dod pa che ge mo bdag gi dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol lo wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥ dbang gi dgug pa la/ khyad par du'ang lha'am mi la sogs pa gang 'gugs par 'dod pa che ge mo bdag gi dbang du 'du ba'i slad du 'gugs par mdzad du gsol lo ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥhrīṃ/ drag po la/ khyad par du'ang bdag cag la sdang zhing 'tshe ba'i dgra'am bgegs che ge mo da lta nyid du drag pos sgrol la sha khrag tshogs kyi 'khor lo lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bzhes shig rol cig /rnam par shes pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang dam pa thob par mdzad du gsol lo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces dang*/ dgra bgegs gdug pa bdud kyi tshogs// sde dpung 'khor dang bcas pa yi// sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs la 'bul// las dang bag chags dag pa dang*// rang gshed bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams// kho rang la ni bzlog pa dang*// rdul cha tsam yang med par mdzod// hūm̐ */ gtum chen 'bar ba khro bo'i rje// 'jigs tshul rngam pa'i nga ro yis// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba dang*// bdag srung rkyen dang bar chad zlog /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ma ma rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i bar yang brjod do// de ltar phrin las bcol ba'i tshe zhi ba la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dkar po/ gos rgyan dkar po shin tu zhi ba'i nyams can 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum dang snyoms par 'jug pa spros pas/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum rnams kyang de dang 'dra ba'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams kyi phyag na zla ba chu shel gyi bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas rang ngam bsgrub bya'i steng phyogs nas chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas/ gang zhi bar 'dod pa rnams skad cig gis zhi bar mdzad par bsam/

rgyas pa la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas nga rgyal gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog ser po/ sku shin tu rgyas pa dgyes shing rangs pa'i nyams can gos rgyan ser po can rin po che 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum dang snyoms par 'jug pa spros pas/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum dang bcas pa de dang 'dra ba'i rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams kyi phyag na gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas rang ngam bsgrub bya la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dang rin po che'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas/ gang rgyas par 'dod pa rnams skad cig la rgyas pa mdzad par bsam/ dbang la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po/ shin tu chags shing brtse ba'i nyams can gos rgyan dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum dang snyoms par 'jug pa spros pas/ de'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum rnams de dang 'dra ba'i rnam par spyan drangs pa 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus gang dbang du bsdu bar 'dod pa de skad cig gis bkug nas ut+pa la kha ma bye ba lta bu'i mde'u can gyi mdas de'i snying phugs nas bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam/ dbang gi dgug pa la/ lha de rnams kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pas gang 'gugs par 'dod pa de'i snying nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te bdag gi mdun du bkug cing dbang du byas par bsam/ drag po la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed nag po/ khro zhing 'khrug pa shin tu drag po'i nyams can gos rgyan nag po can ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra'i yum dang snyoms par 'jug pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum rnams de dang 'dra ba'i rnam par spyan drangs nas bsgrub bya bkug ste/ der gnas pa la lha de rnams cher khros nas rdo rje'i me char phab cing mtshon chas bsgral nas sha zos khrag 'thung rnam shes gtso bo'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' la bstim par bsam/

de ltar phrin las bzhi gang yin yang thun mong du 'dod pa'i phrin las de dag bsgrubs zin nas/ lha de rnams slar yang gtso bo'i thugs kar thim par bsam mo// phrin las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo 'di rnams yin pas dmigs pa de dag gang yin yang gsal la yun ring bar sgom pa gal che'o// gsum pa rjes kyi sdom ni/ rjes ni sreg blug gsum mam bdun// nyer gcig gang rung gshegs skyems su// phul rjes mchod yon zhal bsil dang*// bsang gtor gos zung so rtsi dbul// mchod gtor gtor ma phul nas slar// mchod yon phul la bzod par gsol// 'dod don gsol gdab lhag chad bskang*// ye shes gshegs gsol dam tshig bsdu// thab bsang sreg blugs gcig phul la/ me lha gsal btab nyer spyod dang*// chu bzhi sogs dang so rtsi dbul// rdzas lhag lan gsum phul ba'i mthar// dgang blugs gsum dbul bstod pa bya// gtor ma phul nas mchod bstod bzod gsol| |dngos grub zhu zhing lhag chad bskang*// gshegs gsol shis brjod bsngo smon bya// me gzhil thal sol las mthun sbyang*// bum chus gnas khang bsang gtor bya// zhes pa rnams so// dang po gshegs skyems ni/ oṃ mañju shrī badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+yaḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mar khu blugs gzar gsum bdun nyer gcig phul nas me sbar ba'i rjes su sngar ltar las mthun gyi khu tshur gyis dgang blugs bzung nas sngags snga ma de nyid kyis dgang blugs gsum 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du gshegs su 'bul/ gnyis pa chu gsum dbul pa ni/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du/ wā ra'i mthar/ ā tsa mā naṃ gyis zhal bsil dang*/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor 'bul/ gsum pa gos dang so rtsi ni las mthun gyi gos zung thogs la/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku nyid la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog

/oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā/ zhes 'bul/ so rtsi/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hās 'bul lo// bzhi pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba/ khyad par gyi mchod pa rnams rgyas par ni rab gnas ltar ram/ bsdu na gong ltar mchod bstod gang rung gis bstod do// lnga pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma la sman raka sgron la drag po'i gtor ma byin rlabs kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag gnyis gan rkyal du brkyangs pa'i mthe bong dang gung mo bskyed pas/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ba liṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ slar gong du bshad pa'i bsnyen sngags sam/ mtshan sngags sam/ sgrub sngags kyi gong ma gsum gyi mthar rā tri sogs btags pa de gsum gang rung gis gtor ma thab khung du dbul| drug pa phyag bya zhing mchod yon dbul ba ni/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta kā ya a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes dngos sam yid kyis phyag bya/ de rjes/ oṃ mañju shrī ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon 'bul| bdun pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon pos de kun bzod par mdzod// ma nyes yongs su ma shes dang*// gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun gtso bos bzod par rigs// zhes brjod/ brgyad pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gong ltar thal mo sbyar nas/ lha yi lha mchog sogs dang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa sogs dang*/ lnga brgya dus dang*/ bdag kyang gnod pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par sogs brjod/ gzhan yang las mthun gyi 'dod don gsol ba'i rjes su/ nam mkha' med par gyur na yang*// sogs kyi mthar/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bden pa chen po 'di yongs su grub par gyur cig /grub bo/

grub bo/ grub bo/ zhes brjod/ dgu pa lhag chad kha bskangs nas gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yig brgya lan gsum brjod nas/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥmañju shrī ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra hūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod pas/ lha ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dam tshig pa rnams rang gis dbugs rngub pa dang lhan cig tu rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ bcu pa thab bsang zhing me lha gsal gdab pa ni/ las gshin gyi sngags dang las chus 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du bsangs/ me lha'i sngags kyis blugs gzar gyi sreg blugs gcig phul nas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa la/ slar sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan chas dang bcas pa sngar ltar gsal bar gyur par bsam/ bcu gcig pa nyer spyod ni/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bcu gnyis pa chu bzhi gos dang so rtsi dbul ba ni/ chu bzhi sngar me lha'i skabs ltar ram yang na/ oṃ ag+na ye ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ zhes chu bzhi sngar gyi go rim mi 'dra bar dbul ba 'di khyad par ro// de rjes/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba skyed byed pa'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir dbul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis rgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra ye swā hā/ zhes gos zung dbul/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hā/ so rtsi dbul/ bcu gsum pa rdzas lhag ma dbul ba ni/ yam shing nas rdzas khyad par ba'i bar rnams sngar me lha'i skabs ltar rdzas re re bzhin lan gsum gsum kho nar 'bul te/

gdan bzhi'i gdan dang po las/ lhag ma lan gsum bsregs nas kyang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir lan gsum re kho na 'bul lo// bcu bzhi pa dgang blugs ni/ sngags me lha'i byon zan gyi skabs ltar dgang blugs lan gsum gshegs skyems su 'jam gsum la g.yas skor dang drag po la g.yon skor du phul nas/ bstod pa ni/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag |shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rang don du sgrub pa mang yang*/ rab gnas sogs skabs 'gar gzhan don du byed pa'i tshe skabs 'dir yon bdag sreg blugs 'bul du gzhug pa sogs bya bar spro na/ karma phrin las gnyis pas mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung du gsungs pa ltar bya zhing*/ skabs 'dir slob dpon la yon yang dbul du gzhug go// bco lnga pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ me lha'i gtor ma byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas nas/ oṃ ag+na ye a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma thab khung du 'bul/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod nas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar brjod pas phrin las bcol/ bcu drug pa mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ oṃ ag+na ye ā tsa mā naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhal bsil dang*/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor dang*/ puṣ+paṃ/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ slar/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon phul/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs 'khrul pa'i blos// chad lhag nongs par gang gyur pa// de kun khyod kyis bzod par rigs// zhes bzod par gsol/ bcu bdun pa dngos grub blang zhing lhag chad bskang ba ni/

bsreg bya za ba drang srong me lha'i lha// bdag cag mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu gang*// 'jig rten dang ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i// las bzhi grub pa brgyad dang myang 'das kyi// phun tshogs dngos grub deng 'dir bstsal du gsol// zhes brjod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi bar bya'o// bco brgyad pa gshegs su gsol zhing shis brjod sogs bgyi ba ni/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed bsreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar 'byon la// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// dza hi dza hi/ oṃ muḥ me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ se gol lan gsum gtogs pas/ me lha dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam pa nyid du gyur to// zhes brjod/ bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam gyis brjid chags par bya'o// bcu dgu pa me gzhil nas thal sol sbyang ba sogs ni long yod na me rang zhir btang*/ long med na 'jam gsum la dri bzang gi chu dang*/ drag po la dug khrag gis me gzhil la/ zhi ba'i thal sol chur sbyangs/ rgyas pa'i thal sol mdzod du sba/ dbang gi thal sol ri rtser bskyal/ drag po'i thal sol rlung la 'phyar ba sogs bya/ thal sol chu la sbyangs na chu de nas bum pa gang khyer la gnas khang du gtor de min na las chus gnas khang la bsang gtor bya'o// gnyis pa bsnyen pa'i kha skong du bya tshul sogs nyer mkho phran bu bshad pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg byed par bshad pa ni/ de'ang sdig sgrib zhi ba la zhi ba dang*/ lha mnyes shing tshim par 'dod na rgyas pa bya dgos pas bsnyen pa byas pa'i gnas de nyid du zhi rgyas gang byed kyi thab khung bcas la/ zhi ba la shar dang*/ rgyas pa la byang du kha bltas la sreg rdzas g.yas dang*/ mchod rdzas g.yon du bshams/ sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas ni sngar bshad pa'i zhi rgyas kyi skabs dang 'dra/

bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par sgom pa nas sreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs/ thab khung bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang du bskyed la de'i nang du dkyil 'khor pa sngar 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar bskyed la/ oṃ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags rgyas nam mkhar bteg /las mthun gyi me sbar la mar khu sreg blugs kyis me cher sbar nas/ nam mkhar bteg pa'i lha rnams phab la me dbus su bzhugs su gsol nas/ mchod bstod las gzhung ltar byas rjes/ zhi ba la/ lha sngags mthar/ rdzas sngags la/ bdag gi sdig sgrib dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la/ bdag gi lam rim pa gnyis kyi rtogs pa dang phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos po thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes sogs so sor sbyar nas dbul/ bsdu na/ 'bru gsum gyi mthar spel tshig sbyar bas kyang 'grub par gsung*/ tshul de lta bus sngags 'bum phrag re la sbyin sreg khri phrag re bya'o// de ltar thun rer dgang blugs byas rjes thun gyi mthar mchod bstod dngos grub blangs nas nongs pa bshags la lha rnams rang lus la bsdu/ thab dang rdzas la ras gsar pas g.yogs la sbas te thun mtshams kyi bya ba gzhan la 'jug |yang nongs pa sogs cho ga sngar bzhin bya'o// yang bsnyen pa'i mthar lha dbang du bya ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ gzhan thams cad dbang gi dus ltar la/ thab khung ni zhi ba'i thab khung nyid kha dog dmar po byas pa'i nang du lha bskyed nas bsnyen pa 'bum phrag re la me tog dmar po'i sbyin sreg khri phrag re bya dgos par/ me tog ni khug chos la sogs pa dug med pa'i me tog dmar po gang 'dzom bsres par mngar gsum gyis sbags nas lha sngags mthar/ wa sh+yaṃ ku ru hoḥbatags pa kho nas sreg go// yang 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi lha rigs drug sogs tshim par byed na'ang sngar sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i gshegs su gsol zin pa'i rjes su/

tshangs pa/ drag po/ khyab 'jug sogs rang rang gi yul lha'am/ 'gro ba rigs drug la sogs pa gang yin pa bskyed/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa bcug nas rang rang gi sngags rgyas dbang du byas la mchod cing*/ rang rang gi sngags kyis sbyin sreg ji tsam 'byor ba byas na de rnams tshim zhing sbyin pa rgya chen po 'gyur bar gsungs so// yang las thams cad pa zhes gsungs pa ni/ thab gcig tu las bzhi gar rdzas dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyis bsgrub pa la dgos pa'i thab ni/ zhi ba la las thams cad dkar po/ rgyas pa la thams cad ser po/ dbang la las thams cad dmar po/ drag po la thams cad nag po bya/ tshad dang dbyibs ni de bzhin zhi thab kho na ltar la/ khyad par ni/ thab kyi mu ran la ge sar dang bcas pa'i ze'u 'bru dang*/ kha khyer la pad+ma rgyas pa'i rnam pa can bri/ phyi rol tu phyogs mtshams su rdo rje'am/ sna tshogs rdo rje'am/ ral gris mtshan pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pas bskor/ thab dbus su mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar gtso bo'i mtshan ma bri ba'ang phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon gyi yi ge'am/ tshom bu bkod/ mtshan ma'i kha dog lha'i sku mdog dang mthun par bya/ gzhan chas gos sogs las mthun me lha'i sku mdog las mthun mi dgos par rang mdog kho na bya/ 'das lha'i sku mdog las mthun du bsgyur/ sreg rdzas mar dang yam shing las mthun med ka med du bya/ rdzas gzhan rnams las gang sgrub kyi rdzas gtso bor bya/ rdzas gang yang kha dog las mthun du bsgyur ro/ sngags tshig las gang sgrub kha bsgyur byas pas 'grub par gsungs kyang*/ thams cad pa 'di spros pa chung ba'i ngor gsungs pas/ sngar bshad pa ltar las bzhi so sor grub rjes las thams cad pa med mi rung ba ma yin pa'o// de ltar phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len dang ngag 'don ma tshang ba med cing mdor bsdus pa la go don mtha' gcod dgos gnas la dpyad pa sogs lung rigs kyi spros pa bskyungs nas/

'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag la sbyar ba 'di'ang*/ skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros rgya che ba rnams la cho ga zur tsam gyis go bar 'gyur mod kyang*/ rang nyid blo gros dman pas brjed 'jigs don gnyer gyi 'dod 'dun ches che bar brten las bzhi gar sbyor lugs gsal por bris pa 'di'ang*/ mkhas pa'i dbang po karma phrin las gnyis pa'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung gi lag len dang ngag 'don rnams bkol te bris pa ma gtogs rang bzo spu tsam yang med cing*/ yang 'di nyid go don dang mtha' dpyod 'grel bshad sogs rgyas pa don du gnyer ba dag bshad ma thag pa'i sbyin sreg ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung nyid du rtogs par byos shig /ces pa'ang deng sang bskal dus kyi dbang gis ban sngags kyi yon tan mo bon gto chog la re ba nyid las/ rdo rje theg pa'i phrin las don du gnyer ba chu shing gi snying po ltar mthong yang*/ rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i phrin las sgrub pa'i slad du/ don gnyer re re tsam la phan pa'i blos sa yos cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar tshes drug la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas/ 'bri chos phyug gi klung du bris pa 'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs dus thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ shrī dz+wa la dzam+bu dwīpa a laṅkār ā gats+tsha//
